conceptZh: 彈簧發條的賽車撞開一個糖果盒，蹦出一條長長的舌頭糖和一塊蜂蜜方糖，拼成「甜」字，賽車嚐了一口甜到眼睛變愛心。
object: a squeaky pull-back toy race car with googly eyes, and a candy box that springs open with a lollipop tongue and a honey cube
morph: a candy box bursts open and the left part 舌 and right part 甘 of 甜 pop out and land side by side
creativeAngle: 驚喜彈出：賽車衝過頭撞開糖果盒，盒裡先彈出舌頭形棒棒糖組成「舌」，再彈出方糖組成「甘」，賽車嚐了甜到雙眼變愛心。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and sugary-cheerful, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-lavender backdrop with a pale pink floor. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated raspberry-pink Traditional Chinese glyph 甜, the left part 舌 beside the right part 甘, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The lead is an original squeaky pull-back toy race car, glossy turquoise with big googly eyes, that always overshoots its target; no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the car backs up with a squeak, winds its spring, zooms across the floor, overshoots the middle, and skids into a big striped candy box; the box lid pops open and the left half of the glyph, a stack of pink strokes shaped like the 舌 part, bursts out on a spring like a surprise toy, and the first spoken 甜 lands at the pop. Moment two (1.8-3.4s): the car does a double-take, googly eyes spinning in opposite directions, backs up and rams the box again; the second spoken 甜 lands as the right half 甘 shoots out in the shape of a honey-gold cube-stack and drops beside the first half with a click. Moment three (3.4-5.0s): a tiny lollipop on a stick drops from the box and rolls under the car's front bumper; the car pokes out a long pink tongue and takes a lick, its googly eyes turn into twin pink hearts, and the word 甜點 is spoken as a little cupcake with a cherry pops out of the box and bounces. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 甜 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in raspberry pink; the car sits to the side with heart eyes, wiggling its back wheels happily and giving one tiny squeak, never touching the strokes. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「甜、甜、甜點」, read as ㄊㄧㄢˊ、ㄊㄧㄢˊ、ㄊㄧㄢˊ ㄉㄧㄢˇ, first utterance at about 0.6s, second at about 2.7s, the word at about 4.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only squeaks and soft pops under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter, no real people.

conceptZh: 毛茸茸的獨角大怪獸和發條鯊魚拿巨大糖棒當劍決鬥，兩人揮空轉圈後「咚」地撞頭坐倒，手上的糖棒飛散落下疊成「甜」字，最後一塊杯子蛋糕蹦出來，鯊魚咬空滿鼻奶油原地轉圈。
object: two giant striped candy-stick swords and a spilled bundle of berry-red candy sticks
morph: the head-BOINK knocks both candy swords and a bundle of candy sticks loose; they clatter down and stack as the strokes of 甜, the left bundle forming 舌 and the right forming 甘
creativeAngle: 改用「友誼決鬥」模式：大怪獸與發條鯊魚拿糖棒當劍，揮空、轉圈、撞頭，撞擊本身把糖棒抖落成字，動作全程可見。與前版賽車撞糖果盒、蜂蜜滴落完全不同；怪獸的長舌頭呼應「舌」部，蛋糕蹦出呼應「甜點」一詞，聲音與畫面同步。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animated slapstick clip, locked frontal camera, bright candy-shop colors, no flashing. Setting: a clean pale butter-yellow backdrop with a soft cream floor, nothing busy behind. The only on-screen text is one bold Traditional Chinese glyph 甜 in saturated berry-red, left part 舌 beside right part 甘, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. Cast: an original huge round fuzzy cartoon monster, lilac fur, one stubby horn and a goofy grin, so clumsy it knocks things over just by turning; and an original chunky wind-up toy shark, teal plastic with a big key on its back, that chomps at everything and bites the wrong thing. No real people.

Moment one (0.0-1.6s): the monster and the shark face off from opposite sides of the frame, each gripping a giant striped candy-stick sword; a bundle of berry-red candy sticks is strapped to the monster's back. The monster can't resist, pokes out a long pink tongue and licks its own sword with a dreamy grin as the first spoken 甜 lands at about 0.7s. The shark chomps at the air, impatient.

Moment two (1.6-3.2s): both take enormous wind-ups and swing. The monster whiffs so hard it spins twice, fur flying; the shark bites its own sword instead of swinging and spins in a circle on the floor. They reel toward the center, dizzy.

Moment three (3.2-4.8s): a frozen half-beat as they lean in, then BOINK, foreheads bump with a big squash-and-stretch wobble. Both swords fly out of their hands and the bundle on the monster's back bursts loose; the candy sticks tumble down and clatter into the glyph 甜, the left sticks stacking into 舌 and the right into 甘, snapping into place at about 3.7s exactly as the second spoken 甜 lands. The two sit down on either side, stars circling their heads, grinning.

Moment four (4.8-8.0s): the glyph 甜 stays perfectly still, crisp and unobstructed in the center. At about 5.4s a little cupcake with a cherry pops up between them with a boing as the word 甜點 is spoken; the shark lunges, misses, gets frosting on its nose and spins in a small happy circle, while the monster licks a stray candy stick and wiggles its horn. They shake hands, or fin to paw, at about 7s, never touching the strokes.

Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「甜、甜、甜點」, read as ㄊㄧㄢˊ、ㄊㄧㄢˊ、ㄊㄧㄢˊ ㄉㄧㄢˇ, first at about 0.7s, second at about 3.7s, the word at about 5.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only soft boings, a cartoon BOINK and candy clatters under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.
